Reconsider bill_document_audit's 'declined' label — customer actively attempted retrieval multiple times; 'unavailable/no kWh data' is more accurate than 'declined.' Add note on AM/PM confusion at ~12:20 and flag missing hard-required button_up elements (one-hour block, no-driving-at-computer, phone-vs-in-person specification, verbal 'is that fair' handshake) explicitly in script_coverage/button_up reasoning, since schema requires these and none were clearly executed. Elevate the speaker-label-swap caveat to a prominent top-level note given it affects interpretation of the entire call. Outcome dispute (booked) is supported and should stand once the supporting quote's timestamp is corrected.
